cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Committee,

I am a PhD candidate in Computer Engineering focusing on hybrid evaluation metrics for text summarization and LLM-as-a-judge systems. My work on trustworthy AI and adversarial robustness of explainable AI models gives me a solid grounding in evaluating and improving complex neural systems, which aligns with Deepgram's goal of building robust voice AI foundations.

At Yozgat Bozok University I lead the Computer Technologies Department and coordinate international academic activities. Managing a team, securing collaborations, and co‑founding a technology centre have honed my ability to drive research projects from concept to implementation. I have also conducted visiting research at KIT and the University of Turku, exposing me to cutting‑edge AI labs.

While I have not yet built neural audio codecs, my experience designing hybrid metrics and evaluating large language models equips me to assess and improve latent representations. I am eager to apply my expertise in evaluation, robustness, and model‑centric research to the challenges of latent space modeling for voice AI.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how my background can contribute to Deepgram's innovative research agenda.

Best regards,
Anıl Kuş

answers.why_this_organisation: Deepgram's emphasis on real‑time, scalable voice AI matches my interest in building systems that work at large scale and under diverse conditions. The company's AI‑first culture aligns with my habit of integrating advanced models into daily research workflows.
answers.relevant_experience: I have led research on trustworthy AI and adversarial robustness of explainable AI models, and I co‑founded SmartLab Technology Center where we built prototype AI services. My visiting research at KIT exposed me to audio‑related projects, giving me a foundation for voice AI work.
answers.research_interests: I am interested in evaluating and improving large language models, designing hybrid metrics, and ensuring robustness of AI systems. Extending this to audio, I want to explore how latent representations can be factorized and recombined for high‑quality speech synthesis.
